  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos consistentes, trazendo visão de risco e recomendação;
  • Acompanhar tendências do mercado Agro, produtividade, preços e fatores de risco climático ou operacional;
  • Interagir com equipes comerciais, risco e demais áreas, mantendo boa relação interpessoal e comunicação clara;
  • Contribuir com melhorias de processos, digitalização e otimização de rotinas;
  • Apoiar iniciativas ligadas à adoção de tecnologias e inteligência artificial aplicadas ao crédito e ao agronegócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência de mínimo 5 anos em análise de crédito no setor de agronegócios;

  • Interesse em inteligência artificial, automação e ferramentas de análise de dados aplicadas ao crédito e ao Agro;
  • Visão de risco integrada, considerando cenário climático, preço de commodities, produtividade e merca.

title: NGS Technical Sales Specialist | Genomics & Life Sciences (Brazil)
description:
About the Opportunity


Are you a scientist at heart, passionate about genomics and the power of technology to transform healthcare?

At MGI , we combine scientific excellence with innovation to redefine what’s possible in genetic sequencing and automation.

We’re seeking a NGS Technical Sales Specialist who blends a strong scientific foundation with a consultative commercial mindset — someone who can speak the language of researchers, understand their challenges, and guide them toward solutions that accelerate discovery.


What You’ll Do

Drive Scientific Engagement & Growth

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan for MGI’s sequencing and automation portfolio.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities within universities, hospitals, research institutes, and biotech companies.
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key opinion leaders and research partners.


Act as a Scientific Partner

  • Provide consultative pre- and post-sales support to ensure customers achieve optimal experimental outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Field Application Scientists to deliver a seamless scientific and technical experience.
  • Conduct presentations, workshops, and seminars to demonstrate the impact of MGI technologies on research and clinical applications.


Market Intelligence & Collaboration

  • Stay ahead of market trends in genomics, molecular biology, and precision medicine to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Represent MGI at scientific conferences, trade shows, and regional events as a trusted partner in the life sciences community.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, and R&D to align customer feedback with product innovation.


Reporting & Planning

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, and customer records using CRM tools (Salesforce).
  • Monitor performance metrics and adjust strategies to meet and exceed objectives.


Who You Are

  • A scientist with commercial curiosity — passionate about both research and relationship building.
  • Strong communicator who can translate complex scientific concepts into clear, compelling discussions.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Driven by the opportunity to make genomics more accessible and impactful for all.


What You Bring

Scientific Expertise

  • Solid understanding of genomics, molecular biology, or biotechnology .
  • Hands-on experience with NGS workflows, DNA/RNA sequencing, or lab automation .


Commercial Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in life science sales, business development, or field-based scientific roles .
  • Proven record of achieving or exceeding sales goals through consultative, science-driven engagement.


Education & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; Master’s or Ph.D. preferred .
  • English: Advanced | Spanish: Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite .
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across Brazil.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance .
  • Meal stipend and fitness allowance to support wellbeing.


About MGI

MGI is a global leader in genomics innovation, delivering advanced sequencing and automation solutions that empower scientists and healthcare professionals worldwide.

Our mission is to make high-quality, affordable genomics accessible to all — enabling discoveries that improve lives and transform the future of medicine.

Join us and help shape the next generation of genomics.

title: Gen AI Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "Gen AI Engineer" who wants to learn and transform his career


This role will focus on developing and implementing generative AI solutions to enhance nuclear operations, safety protocols, maintenance procedures, and operational efficiency. combine expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning with an understanding of nuclear industry requirements to create transformative AI applications that support safe, reliable nuclear power generation.



Responsibility :


  • Design, develop, and deploy generative AI solutions tailored to nuclear operations, including large language models, document generation, and intelligent automation systems
  • Collaborate with nuclear engineers, operations personnel, and subject matter experts to identify opportunities for AI-driven improvements in safety, efficiency, and compliance
  • Build and fine-tune AI models for nuclear-specific applications such as procedure generation, technical documentation analysis, predictive maintenance, and operational decision support
  • Ensure all AI solutions comply with nuclear regulatory requirements (NRC) and industry standards for safety-critical systems
  • Develop prompt engineering strategies and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for nuclear knowledge management
  • Implement robust testing, validation, and monitoring frameworks for AI models in high-stakes environments
  • Create and maintain documentation for AI models, algorithms, and deployment processes
  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their applicability to nuclear operations
  • Participate in cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions with existing nuclear systems and workflows.
  • Experience in regulated industries (energy, nuclear, aerospace, or healthcare)
  • Knowledge of nuclear operations, safety protocols, or regulatory environment
  • Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and semantic search technologies
  • Familiarity with AI governance, ethics, and responsible AI practices
  • Understanding of cybersecurity principles for AI systems
  • Experience with model fine-tuning, evaluation metrics, and performance optimization
  • Background in human-AI interaction and user-centered AI design
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred)
  • 3+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering with focus on generative AI technologies
  • Strong proficiency in Python and AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain)
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and prompt engineering
  • Understanding of NLP, transformer architectures, and foundation models
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps practices
  • Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance for nuclear facility access
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills



What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

• Conhecimento em automação de infraestrutura (PowerShell, Bash, Ansible, Terraform desejável).


Diferenciais

• Experiência com ambientes multi-cloud ou cloud híbrida.

description:

  • 2–5 anos  como SDR/BDR ou AE vendendo SaaS/MarTech para varejo ou e-commerce.

  • Português nativo  e inglês intermediário-avançado; domínio diário de Apollo e HubSpot (ou ferramentas equivalentes).
  • Zero medo de telefone e disponibilidade para viajar ≈ 25 %  dentro do Brasil.

  • Negócios fechados ≥ USD 30 k ARR.
  • Rede de contatos C-Level em varejo/e-commerce.
  • Experiência mentorando SDRs júnior.


Competências que valorizamos


  1. Prospeção magistral  – cold-calling sem desculpas.
  2. Storytelling C-Suite  – transforma dados em narrativas claras e convincentes.

Por que a Hellotext?


  • Produto líder, 100 % focado em comércio eletrônico latino-americano.

  • Cultura de propriedade, ação rápida e transparência .

Seu desempenho será avaliado pessoalmente pelo CEO , então reserve uma hora sem interrupções e dê o melhor de si em uma única sessão.

title: Government Relations Director, Brazil
description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumers


in more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and

lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help

everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their

individuality through access to the latest trends.


SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.


Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.


In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.


Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms


Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Telecommunications Project Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Project Manager in the Telecommunications sector to lead complex initiatives involving network deployment, modernization, and expansion. This professional will be responsible for delivering projects on time, within scope, budget, and quality standards, while ensuring strong alignment between clients, technical teams, vendors, and senior management.


This is a full on-site position at our São Paulo – Berrini office.



Key Responsibilities


  • Plan, execute, monitor, and close telecom projects (RAN, Core, IP, FTTH, DWDM, power and site infrastructure).
  • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, and quality indicators (SLAs, KPIs), ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and customer requirements.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams (engineering, deployment, logistics, suppliers, and subcontractors).
  • Lead regular meetings with telecom operators and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparency, governance, and alignment.
  • Identify, analyze, and mitigate technical, operational, and commercial risks.
  • Prepare and present executive reports to clients and senior management, highlighting progress, risks, and key decisions.
  • Ensure compliance with telecom regulations (e.g., ANATEL) and international quality standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management processes, aiming at efficiency, scalability, and cost optimization.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Project Management, Telecommunications, or related areas is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in project management, with a strong background in the telecommunications sector.
  • Solid experience in project management within the telecommunications sector (mobile networks, fixed networks, or backbone).
  • Strong technical knowledge of telecom technologies (4G/5G RAN, IP/MPLS, DWDM, FTTH, power and infrastructure for telecom sites).
  • Proven experience managing projects of high complexity, involving multiple vendors and Tier-1 telecom operators.
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies (PMBOK, Agile, hybrid).
  • Certifications are a plus: PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, ITIL.
  • English is the primary working language; fluency is required. Portuguese fluency both written and spoken is a must.
  • Availability to work full on-site at the São Paulo – Berrini office.



Preferred Competencies


  • Strong leadership skills and ability to engage technical and field teams.
  • Excellent negotiation skills with clients, partners, and vendors.
  • Established professional relationship with major Brazilian telecom operators (TIM, Claro, Vivo, Oi/Algar) is highly desirable.
  • Analytical thinking and result-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work under pressure in demanding and dynamic environments.
  • Clear and structured communication for both technical and executive audiences.



What We Offer


  • Opportunity to lead high-impact projects for major telecom operators.
  • Multicultural and dynamic environment with direct interface with international stakeholders.
  • Competitive compensation package and continuous training programs.

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities.   6. Standardization and Knowledge Accumulation: Establish and maintain process operation standards, create user-friendly operational guidelines and qualification criteria for frontline teams, ensuring efficient execution and compliance.

O QUE A MAPFRE ESPERA DE VOCÊ

  • Superior completo;
  • Pós-graduação desejável;
  • CNH ativa;
  • Disponibilidade de horário e para viagens;
  • Vivência comercial no setor de seguros, com foco em canais digitais e parcerias estratégicas;

LOCAL: BERRINI;

A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale-Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Key Account Manager com sólida experiência no segmento de confecção de moda, para liderar a estratégia comercial da empresa junto ao time de representantes comerciais, fortalecer o relacionamento com clientes, expandir a carteira e garantir o atingimento das metas de vendas.


Esta posição exige visão estratégica, capacidade de liderança e profundo conhecimento do mercado de moda, streetwear ou esportivo, incluindo diferentes canais de venda: atacado, varejo e e-commerce.

  • Gerenciar e orientar a equipe de vendas, promovendo alinhamento com os objetivos e valores da empresa.
  • Prospectar novos clientes e mercados nos canais B2B e B2C (atacado, multimarcas, digital).
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs), como volume de vendas, ticket médio, margem, conversão e outros.
  • Realizar negociações estratégicas com grandes contas, definindo políticas comerciais, descontos, condições de pagamento e prazos de entrega.
  • Planejar e coordenar ações promocionais, lançamentos de coleção e participação em feiras ou showrooms.
  • Analisar o desempenho das coleções, oferecendo insights para o desenvolvimento de produtos alinhados à demanda de mercado.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com clientes-chave, buscando fidelização e parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Mapear tendências de mercado e concorrência, antecipando oportunidades e riscos.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Marketing, Merchandising, Sourcing, Logística e Finanças, garantindo fluidez e sinergia no ciclo comercial.
  • Elaborar previsões de vendas e relatórios gerenciais para a diretoria.
  • Gerenciar pedidos e controlar prazos de entregas.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Moda ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada de no mínimo 4 anos como Key Account Manager ou função similar.
  • Forte habilidade de negociação, gestão de equipes e planejamento estratégico.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com metas e entrega de resultados.
  • Conhecimento dos canais de vendas (varejo, atacado e e-commerce) e comportamento do consumidor de moda.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais.
  • Habilidade em relacionamento interpessoal e engajamento de pares e colaboradores.
  • Alta capacidade de gestão de conflitos e negociações complexas.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório).
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.

title: ANALISTA PLANEJAMENTO COMERCIAL SR
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.


Como será seu dia a dia:


Você fará parte do time de Planejamento, atuando diretamente no desdobramento de metas e na apuração dos resultados dos canais de captação de matrículas. No dia a dia, será responsável por acompanhar o desempenho dos canais e vendedores, garantindo a correção das remunerações variáveis (RVs) e a consistência dos indicadores de performance.

Além das rotinas de apuração, você também irá contribuir com a análise de resultados e geração de insights, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e crescimento nos canais, modalidades e períodos de captação.

Essa posição tem um papel importante na evolução analítica da área, ajudando o time a sair do operacional e avançar para análises mais estratégicas, com projeções, recomendações e inovação — seja através de automações, modelos preditivos ou novas formas de olhar os dados.

Buscamos alguém proativo, analítico e com autonomia, capaz de entender os processos, buscar informações e propor soluções sem depender de direcionamentos constantes.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

• Desenvolver e gerenciar o calendário comercial, alinhando sazonalidades e oportunidades para impulsionar a captação;

• Monitorar e analisar o posicionamento da concorrência, avaliando estratégias de precificação, diferenciais e comunicação;

• Identificar tendências de mercado e oportunidades de captação, fornecendo insights ao time comercial;

• Ser ponto focal do time comercial com a área de marketing, garantindo que as demandas sejam atendidas com agilidade;

• Criar e manter um dashboard de competitividade por região;

• Criar briefings para as áreas de marketing e acompanhar a criação de materiais e conteúdos comerciais (folders, apresentações, e-mails, materiais digitais, roteiros de vendas);

• Monitorar a performance das campanhas comerciais, sugerindo ajustes para otimizar conversão e engajamento do time de vendas;

• Criar e disponibilizar guias e treinamentos sobre diferenciais competitivos para os consultores de vendas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência em planejamento comercial, inteligência de mercado ou trade marketing;

• Habilidade para gestão de múltiplas demandas e interface com áreas de vendas e marketing;

• Habilidade avançada em Excel e ferramentas de BI (Power BI ou similares);

• Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para produzir apresentações claras e objetivas;

• Proativo, organizado e com foco em execução e impacto em resultados;

• Analítico e orientado por dados, mas com visão prática para transformar análises em ações comerciais.

Informações adicionais:


Modelo de trabalho híbrido (2x na semana presenciais)

Temos alguns escritórios espalhados pelo Brasil, mas você ficará alocado na Paulista.


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.

Este profissional atua como referência técnica para as equipes de loja, supervisionando, orientando e treinando os colaboradores para que as diretrizes de exposição, vitrines, layout e comunicação visual sejam executadas com qualidade e consistência.

  • Planejar, organizar e acompanhar montagem de vitrines, displays e layout interno, seguindo o calendário de campanhas e lançamentos.
  • Treinar e capacitar equipes de loja em técnicas de exposição, organização e manutenção visual.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de performance relacionados à exposição e vendas, propondo ações que otimizem conversão e giro de produtos.

  • Garantir que as lojas estejam sempre atrativas, organizadas e alinhadas à experiência de marca desejada.
  • Atuar de forma proativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria, inovações visuais e tendências do varejo.
  • Assegurar que todas as ações estejam em conformidade com os padrões e políticas da marca.



Qualificações



  • Formação superior completa ou cursando em Design de Moda, Administração, Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Visual Merchandising, preferencialmente em varejo de moda, calçados, artigos esportivos ou bens de consumo.
  • Vivência na execução de campanhas, vitrines, layouts de loja e estratégias visuais.
  • Habilidade em treinar, orientar e liderar equipes para garantir a padronização e qualidade das ações de VM.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interação com equipes internas e gestores.
  • Conhecimento de tendências de mercado e comportamento do consumidor aplicadas ao varejo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos e múltiplas demandas, mantendo atenção aos detalhes e consistência visual.

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.


Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation


For more information, you may check our website：


Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.


Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

Com isso, adotamos iniciativas inovadoras para clientes e parceiros.

Na Pefisa tudo é simples. Tudo é rápido. Te ajudamos com o que você precisa para realizar seus sonhos ou alavancar seu negócio. E você escolhe como quer conversar, pois nós somos Fígital. Atuamos com a melhor experiência entre o físico e o digital, com nossas plataformas digitais ou através de nossas lojas físicas. Somos a fintech pra gente como a gente.


Analista de Controles Internos e Conformidades Jr (Foco RO, Compliance e CI)

O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description


Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.


Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. title: Analista de Sinistros Pleno
description:
SOBRE A SEDGEWICK:

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado. Uma carreira na Sedgwick é onde a paixão encontra o propósito de gerar um impacto positivo no mundo por meio das pessoas e organizações que servimos. Se você é uma pessoa motivada a fazer a diferença, que gosta de desafios e, acima de tudo, é uma pessoa que se importa, há um lugar para você aqui. Junte-se a nós e contribua para que a Sedgwick seja um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.


Great Place to Work®

Top 100 Most Loved Workplace®

Melhor empregador do estado de acordo com a Forbes



OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Realizar todas as etapas de um processo de regulação de sinistros. Seus principais objetivos incluem garantir uma resposta eficiente e eficaz aos sinistros relatados pelos segurados, assegurando uma resolução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes envolvidas. Atuar na análise detalhada das circunstâncias do sinistro, na avaliação dos danos e na determinação das coberturas aplicáveis à apólice de seguro. Conduzir as comunicações com os segurados, corretores, agentes e outros envolvidos no processo, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e negociando acordos quando necessário. O Analista de Sinistros também trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, financeiro e atendimento ao cliente, para resolver pendências e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações do setor de seguros. Suas atividades envolvem desde a coleta inicial de informações sobre o sinistro até a conclusão do processo, incluindo a liquidação de valores de indenização e o encerramento do caso de forma satisfatória para todas as partes. Este profissional tem um maior foco técnico, com uma relação mais profunda com as etapas de Regulação de Sinistros.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:


  • Receber e registrar notificações de sinistros relatados por segurados, corretores ou agentes, e realizar uma análise inicial das circunstâncias do sinistro (pré-análise)
  • Conduzir investigações detalhadas sobre a validade e a extensão do sinistro, incluindo a avaliação de danos, coleta de evidências e entrevistas com testemunhas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar vistoria remota assistida através das tecnologias da Sedgwick coletando imagens para compor o laudo/processo do Sinistro, de acordo com as especificidades de cada ramo, condições gerais do produto e determinações dos Clientes.
  • Determinar a aplicabilidade das coberturas da apólice ao sinistro reportado, verificando os termos, condições e limitações da apólice de seguro.
  • Estabelecer comunicação com os segurados para fornecer orientações sobre o processo de regulação de sinistros, esclarecer dúvidas e solicitar documentação adicional, quando necessário.
  • Negociar acordos e resoluções com os segurados, corretores, agentes ou terceiros envolvidos no sinistro, com o objetivo de alcançar uma solução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes, quando aplicável ao escopo contratado pelos Clientes da Sedgwick.
  • Solicitar e coletar documentos relevantes relacionados ao sinistro, como registros médicos, estimativas de reparo, relatórios policiais e outros documentos necessários para a análise e avaliação do sinistro, de acordo com a documentação exigida por cada Cliente para as coberturas dos produtos comercializados.
  • Determinar a responsabilidade das partes envolvidas no sinistro e avaliar os impactos na resolução do sinistro, considerando as leis, regulamentos, condições gerais do produto, coberturas e demais aspectos do sinistro que está sendo analisado, resultando em um pagamento total, parcial ou a uma negativa de indenização.
  • Avaliar os danos causados pelo sinistro e determinar os valores de indenização de acordo com as coberturas da apólice e os procedimentos estabelecidos pela Seguradora.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre a investigação, análise e resolução do sinistro, documentando todas as etapas do processo e as decisões tomadas, de acordo com o Book de Regras de cada Cliente da Sedgwick.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar pendências relacionadas aos sinistros em aberto, garantindo que sejam resolvidas de forma oportuna e eficiente, buscando apoio das áreas internas da Sedgwick, Seguradora ou Corretora e/ou buscando solucionar pendências junto ao cliente, como por exemplo a obtenção de documentação complementar.
  • Registrar todas as atividades, decisões e informações relevantes sobre os sinistros nos sistemas de gerenciamento de sinistros da Sedgwick e/ou dos Clientes, garantindo a precisão e a integridade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, atendimento ao cliente, financeiro e etc, para resolver questões e pendências relacionadas aos sinistros, buscando sua solução com a maior qualidade possível no menor tempo possível.

title: Analista de Controladoria de Fundos
description:
Sobre a Prisma:

A Prisma Capital é uma empresa de investimentos alternativos fundada em 2017 que oferece soluções criativas para problemas complexos que exigem capital de longo prazo. A equipe da Prisma Capital é experiente, multidisciplinar e com um histórico de mais de R$ 12bi implantados com retornos atrativos. A Prisma tem sede em São Paulo, 66 funcionários e possui em torno de R$ 22bi sob gestão.


A Prisma tem um mandato de investimento altamente flexível que inclui um espectro completo de transações estruturadas, independentemente do tamanho, classe de ativo ou setor. A Prisma acredita que essa abordagem multiestratégia é fundamental para a geração de retornos não correlacionados com os ciclos macroeconômicos brasileiros.


Overview da Posição:

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Controladoria com boa comunicação, senso crítico, com forte atenção aos detalhes e comprometido com a alta qualidade das entregas. O profissional será responsável por criar, implementar e acompanhar controles rigorosos para os ativos e passivos de toda a estrutura de fundos onshore e offshore da nossa gestora, além de coordenar o processo de auditoria e revisar as demonstrações financeiras e contábeis dos fundos.


Responsabilidade:

  • Controle das carteiras (Divulgação de cotas, reconciliação de informações divulgadas pelo administrador, validação de cálculos);
  • Suporte a áreas internas (Relatórios para investidores, fornecimento de informações regulatórias);
  • Suporte ao processo de auditoria dos fundos e revisão de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Controle de cotistas (Reconciliação das posições, análise de distribuições, chamadas de capital etc.);
  • Análise da rentabilidade dos fundos (Variações nos valores dos ativos e passivos, análise dos impactos mais relevantes);
  • Marcação a mercado de diversos tipos de ativos, líquidos e ilíquidos (Revisão e validação da precificação dos ativos em carteira, comparações com modelagens gerenciais);
  • Coordenação do processo de avaliação de ativos de Private Equity;


Desejável:

  • Coordenação das atividades de US tax compliance e reports de FATCA/CRS com prestadores;
  • Interface com administrador de fundos offshore sediados em Cayman, Canadá e USA, instruindo e revisando a contabilidade, demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, Econômicas, Contábeis, Administração e Engenharias;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Experiência anterior em asset management ou similar;
  • Diferencial: experiência em fundos offshore com investidores estrangeiros.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About WSO2

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) products. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of APIs for secure delivery of digital services and applications, enabling thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries globally to drive their digital transformation journeys. Our open-source, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in, enabling rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has over 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with nearly USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more. Follow WSO2 on LinkedIn and X (formerly Twitter).


About the Role

As a Software Engineer in WSO2’s Customer Success Team, you will ensure the efficient and effective implementation of technical support and consultancy services to WSO2 customers, enabling them to use our solutions for business success.

Your key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate innate curiosity, an analytical mindset, and a proactive approach to exploring the unknown.
  • Embrace new challenges with a self-starting attitude, collaborating seamlessly with a global team.
  • Take ownership of intricate technical problems, steering them to resolution individually and effectively collaborating with the engineering team during escalations.
  • Exhibit an amiable personality, coupled with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, showcasing sensitivity to the diverse cultures within WSO2's global customer base.
  • Introduce innovative ideas to enhance product and overall technical designs.
  • Actively contribute to both technical and non-technical discussions through email and in-person interactions.
  • Collaborate with extended teams, including engineering, pre-sales, marketing, and sales, on product and customer-related activities.
  • Deliver technical consultancy and training on WSO2 technologies and products for our customers.
  • Maintain flexible working hours to accommodate the dynamic needs of customers.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or Engineering.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Programming skills in Java.
  • Experience in and knowledge of enterprise technologies, e.g., API management, enterprise integration, and identity and access management.
  • An effective communicator with an amiable personality and a passion for building business relationships.
  • Experience in WSO2’s solutions will be an added advantage.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We've built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it's important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual's strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering cutting-edge sequencing technologies and advancing life sciences research worldwide. We are dedicated to enabling affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding our impact across the Americas. If you’re passionate about genomics, NGS, and making a real difference in healthcare and research, join us on this exciting journey toward accessible innovation for all.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking an experienced NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM to lead our Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Bioinformatics, Quality, and Customer Experience teams across Latin America. This leadership role requires a solid scientific foundation in molecular biology, genetics, bioinformatics, or related life sciences, combined with strong operational and people management skills. You will ensure exceptional customer support, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across all post-sales service functions in the region.



RESPONSIBILITIES



  • Report directly to the Head of LATAM and collaborate closely with Global Technical Support, Training, Sales, and Service Operations leaders.
  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team including Field Application Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Field Bioinformaticians, and Customer Support professionals.

  • Define individual training and development needs across the technical team and recommend staffing plans and hiring strategies.
  • Establish measurable goals and performance indicators (e.g., response time, first-time resolution, quality metrics).
  • Manage regional service operations including resource allocation, travel budgets, spare part inventory, and field reporting.
  • Ensure accurate communication and coordination between LATAM and global operations, cascading critical updates and initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical and operational lead for the Customer Experience Center (CEC) and Demo Lab, driving technical demonstrations and customer engagement.
  • Maintain alignment with global quality standards, ensuring compliance, traceability, and continuous improvement of support processes.
  • Able to support and coordinate teams across the LATAM time zones.


QUALIFICATIONS



  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Strong academic background or work experience in NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) is highly preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical support, field service, or applications management, ideally within the genomics or life sciences industry.
  • Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience guiding technical and scientific teams.
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities; capable of navigating global structures and driving results across functions.
  • Willingness to travel regionally and internationally, including occasional training or collaboration trips to China.

MGI offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to employees and their dependents (including domestic partners), which includes:

MGI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Coordenador de contabilidade

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis (obrigatória) com CRC ativo .
  • Experiência sólida em coordenação contábil, contabilidade geral ou controladoria.
  • Conhecimento avançado de US GAAP e das normas brasileiras (CPC/IFRS).

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

title: Product Owner (PO) Técnico/Analista de Negocios Sr
description:
Product Owner, PO Técnico ou Analista de Negócios Sênior

INGLES FLUENTE

  • Conhecimento em plataformas de crédito ou antifraude.

Resumo do Cargo

Buscamos um Product Owner (PO) Técnico altamente motivado para liderar a frente de consumo de dados e relatórios dentro da workstream de modernização. O PO será a ponte essencial entre as necessidades de negócio e a complexidade técnica da integração de dados em arquiteturas cloud-native .   • Atuar como stakeholder primário para validação de entregas técnicas e de negócio.

  • Trabalhar ativamente com o time de Engenharia para definir os schemas de dados e a governança de APIs.
  • Qualidade e Migração de Dados:
  • Liderar a fase de análise de dados migrados de sistemas legados para a nuvem , garantindo a integridade, a qualidade e a equivalência das informações.

  • Liderar o discovery e o refinamento de requisitos complexos, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis e performáticas.

title: Formulation Scientist
description:
Position Summary


The role will provide technical support for local laboratory work, with a primary focus on formulation development to support customer projects, the promotion of Vantage™ products, and customer events. Responsibilities include preparing reports and applying Vantage™ raw materials in formulations, with the goal of providing practical tools for the sales force and supporting strategic customers in the region.


The Research Scientist – Formulation & Application will be a science-driven project leader, responsible for planning, managing, supporting, and executing formulation and product development projects in LATAM, with a special emphasis on Brazil. This role will work closely with global R&D and Marketing teams, ideating, identifying, and developing new products for market launch, contributing to the growth of Vantage Personal Care in LATAM and globally.


Key responsibilities include developing formulations for major customers and evaluating their performance to demonstrate the benefits of our technologies, developing new personal care applications, and creating market-relevant concepts that promote Vantage™ technologies through marketing campaigns, customer events, trade shows, and industry activities. In addition, this role will design and perform (or coordinate) the necessary

performance tests to demonstrate and reinforce the value proposition of Vantage™ technologies.


Position Scope


The position will be located in Brasil.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


· Development of new formulations to highlight ingredients from Vantage portfolio and their added values in formulation (skin care, hair care, makeup, and toiletries applications) according to internal and external needs, such as Marketing campaigns, trade shows, customers events and needs etc.

· Support in tests for performance studies and sensorial tests for costumer projects.

· Contribute to new product development projects to improve VPC product portfolio, including discovering new products based on market trends and customers feedback, assessing technical feasibility, developing the new product, designing and conducting needed performance tests to improve the product design, and finalizing product specs, etc.

· Monitor stability testing of formulations: organoleptic and physicochemical analyses.

· Qualification of Vantage ingredients and issue the report with the results.

· Ensure the efficient operation of the laboratory (respect for SOPs, raw materials and packaging inventory management…).

· Use knowledge of routine laboratory safety procedures, SDS’s and interpretations of hazards/toxicity data to perform all laboratory work in accordance with the written safety manual and site safety policies.

· Be a steward for safety and continually drive awareness to ensure a safe work environment for all employees.

· Understand formulation procedures and technologies and incorporate this understanding into applications that add value to customer products.

· Maintain accurate records of all laboratory work and research in accordance with generally accepted laboratory principles.

· Manage the calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment.


Note: The duties listed above are not all inclusive and may be subject to periodic updating or revision.


Education & Experience:


Education: Bachelor of Chemistry, Pharmacobiology, Cosmetics Technology, Pharmacy or related areas, linked to sciences (Chemistry).


Experience: between 5 to 8 years’ working experience in the cosmetics and chemical industry.




Knowledge, Skills, & Talents


· Spanish and English speaker.

· Knowledge of development Personal Care products (Formulation & process).

· Being responsible, organized, proactive, problem-solving, easy to work in a team are characteristics inherent to the vacancy profile

· Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

· Ability to influence and work in cross functional teams.

· Excellent communication skills (oral and written) and interpersonal skills.

· Natural collaborator, contributing to a positive team dynamic.

· Continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to optimize processes.

title: Senior Technical Manager – Fixed Networks & Infrastructure

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management

Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.


Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations


Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies
  • Multi-vendor platforms: ZTE, Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, Cisco optical/routing equipment


Deployment & Operations

  • Complex cutover management and phased rollout strategies with zero service disruption
  • Multi-tier support framework design and escalation matrix implementation
  • Data-driven spares management and predictive maintenance programs
  • Vendor negotiation and RMA cycle management
  • Process automation and provisioning timeline reduction


Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to identify and develop high-potential talent, assessing how candidates think and solve problems under pressure
  • Building high-performing teams in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Strategic mindset balancing operational needs with long-term architectural vision
  • Cross-functional collaboration across deployment, support, procurement, and vendor management


Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)


Plus/Nice to Have

  • Wireless network experience (4G/5G RAN, microwave backhaul, small cells, DAS)
  • Wireless-wireline convergence architectures
  • Spectrum management and RF planning knowledge


Why Join Us


✅ Strategic Influence: Direct access to executive leadership shaping company direction

✅ Technical Autonomy: Select technologies, design architectures, and optimize operations

✅ Operational Impact: Transform deployment, support, and maintenance organization-wide

✅ Market Leadership: Partner with tier-1 carriers on

title: Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil)
description:
We are a leading global fintech company providing cross-border payment solutions to enterprises worldwide, with operations across North America, Europe, the UK, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. As we strategically expand into the Brazilian market, we are seeking a seasoned Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil) to ensure full compliance of our local operations with Brazilian financial regulations, data protection laws (LGPD), AML/KYC requirements, and payment system frameworks. This role will serve as the primary liaison with local regulators (e.g., Banco Central do Brasil, Receita Federal, ANPD), lead compliance implementation, adapt technical systems to regulatory expectations, and support routine audits, while closely collaborating with global compliance and engineering teams to embed compliance into product development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical compliance liaison between the company and Brazilian regulators (including but not limited to Banco Central do Brasil, CVM, ANPD, Receita Federal);representing the engineering in regulatory engagements that involve system architecture, data flows, business contingency, audit logging, and other technical implementation aspects of compliance.
  • Participate in Brazil market-related requirements and project reviews, providing technical compliance oversight to assess requirements and ensure that products, technical architecture, and operational processes comply with Brazilian financial, payments, and data privacy regulations (such as LGPD, PIX-related rules, and BCB Resolutions), thereby enabling legally compliant business operations.;
  • Collaborate with global Compliance, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable technical specifications and system controls;
  • Support internal and external audits (e.g., SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) and prepare regulatory filings and compliance reports;
  • Continuously monitor regulatory developments in Brazil, assess impact on existing business and technical architecture, and propose mitigation strategies;
  • Drive the systematic and standardized documentation of technical artifacts to enhance compliance efficiency and auditability;
  • Provide compliance training and guidance to local business teams to foster a strong compliance culture.



Qualifications:


Required Qualifications

  • Language : Native-level Portuguese (written and spoken); fluent English for global collaboration;
  • Local Regulatory Knowledge : Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial regulatory landscape, including BCB payment system rules (e.g., PIX, SPB), AML/CFT regulations, and LGPD data protection requirements;
  • Technical Acumen : Familiarity with modern payment technology architectures (e.g., API-first, microservices, cloud infrastructure); ability to engage engineering teams on technical details such as data flows, encryption, and audit logging;
  • Hands-on Experience : Direct experience engaging with Brazilian regulators, submitting licensing applications, or managing on-site inspections;
  • Education : Bachelor’s degree or higher in Law, Finance, Information Technology, Risk Management, or related field.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Hold professional certifications such as CISSP, CAMS, CRCM, or similar;
  • Prior experience in fintech, payment institutions, or banking compliance roles;
  • Familiarity with international compliance standards (e.g., FATF Recommendations, GDPR, PCI-DSS) and their local implementation;
  • Experience working in multicultural teams and supporting cross-border compliance initiatives.


What We Offer


  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class compliance and engineering experts;
  • Continuous professional development and learning resources;
  • Inclusive, diverse, and results-driven culture.
